$schema-comment: Size caps for the rendered prompt. UTF-8 byte counts. The CI gate fails if the actual size exceeds the cap. Caps are intentionally close to current size so 0.0.P trim work has headroom without inviting regression.

max_prompt_bytes.why: Current rendered prompt is ~15.4 KB post-v0.6.25 §5.5 Layer 2 (added ~1.0 KB of turn-budget self-rationing rules + emit-reserve discipline). Cap bumped 14500 → 16000 with v0.6.25; still well below the 18500 pre-0.0.P cap. Layer 2's prompt expansion is load-bearing for the Smart Budget System (rules describe how the AI rations its turn budget); shrinkage candidates land if calibration data shows the rules can be expressed more tightly. See CHANGELOG [0.6.25].

max_prompt_lines.why: Current is ~325 lines post-v0.6.25 §5.5 Layer 2 (+~25 lines for the Turn budget self-rationing section). Cap bumped 310 → 340 with v0.6.25. See CHANGELOG [0.6.25].
